title: SSC CPO Paper-1 Full Length Mock Test 02 (Hard Level)

questions.question: P is the brother of Q. R is the father of P. S is the brother of R. How is S related to Q?
questions.explanation: S is brother of Q's father R, so S is uncle of Q.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A man walks 12 km North, turns right 5 km, turns right 12 km, turns left 3 km. How far is he from start?
questions.explanation: After two right turns he is 5 km East of start, then left 3 km North → distance √(5²+3²)=√34≈5.8 not in options. Path: N12, East5, South12 (back to E-W line 5 km East), left from South is East 3 → total East 8 km. Distance 8 km.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Statements: All locks are keys. Some keys are doors. Conclusions: I. Some locks are doors. II. All keys are locks.
questions.explanation: All locks⊂keys; some keys are doors does not force locks∩doors. II is converse false.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Five friends A,B,C,D,E sit in a row. B is not at either end. A is to the left of C. E is at the right end. D is between B and E. Who is in the middle?
questions.explanation: E right end. D between B and E ⇒ order _ _ B D E. B not at end so not position 1. Remaining A,C in first two with A left of C ⇒ A C B D E. Middle is D.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Statement: Only graduates are eligible for the post. Conclusions: I. Some graduates are not eligible. II. All eligible persons are graduates.
questions.explanation: 'Only graduates are eligible' means eligible ⊂ graduates, so all eligible are graduates. I does not necessarily follow.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If 15 August 2024 was Thursday, what day was 15 August 2025?
questions.explanation: From 15 Aug 2024 to 15 Aug 2025 is 365 days (Feb 2024 leap day already passed). 365 days = +1 weekday, so Friday.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: At what time between 2 and 3 o'clock are the hands at right angle for the first time?
questions.explanation: At 2:00 the angle is 60 degrees. To become 90 degrees the minute hand must gain 30 degrees. Time = 30/5.5 = 60/11 minutes = 2:5 5/11.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: In a row of 40 students, A is 11th from the left and B is 8th from the right. How many students are between A and B?
questions.explanation: B from left = 40-8+1=33. Between A(11) and B(33): 33-11-1=21.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: What is the rank of P from the top in a class of 40? (I) P is 12th from the bottom. (II) There are 28 students above P.
questions.explanation: I: rank from top = 40-12+1=29. II: rank from top = 29. Either is enough.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: How many triangles are there in a figure of a large triangle divided by joining midpoints of all sides (midpoint triangle)?
questions.explanation: 4 small upward/down mix + 1 large = 5 triangles when connecting midpoints (medial triangle yields 4 small congruent + no extra). Connecting midpoints gives 4 small triangles of equal size.
